name: residual_inventory_transfer_transition
objective: Find a causal BTC long/short sleeve whose interaction between premium-residualized spot-perpetual basis stress and unexplained delayed-OI ownership transitions improves the frozen Gross9 portfolio rather than merely adding correlated leverage.

economic_hypothesis.claim: A spot-perpetual basis residual is not tradable by itself, and unexplained leveraged inventory is not tradable by itself. Their interaction may be useful when abnormal basis stress is actively widening and newly created inventory is owned by the side implied by completed carry. A transition from one ownership/stress state to another can identify leveraged inventory absorption or release.
tradable_mechanism: long-window basis residual removes the completed premium-index component from the direct spot-perpetual basis
short-minus-long residual acceleration distinguishes actively widening tails from stale extreme levels
delayed OI conservation residual identifies inventory creation unexplained by absolute return, signed return, premium, and funding
completed carry sign labels the likely owner of excess inventory without acting as a standalone alpha
the previous 12-hour state and current state determine posterior long-versus-short executable utility

primary_axes: causal inventory-conservation residual z-score at 288 bars
carry sign used only as excess-inventory ownership label
empirical-Bayes previous-state to current-state executable utility
explicitly_excluded: raw spot participation and spot/perpetual return-gap features
raw OI return and raw taker-imbalance features
Rank7 nested-barrier, market-braid, and source-gate features
unavailable spot quote-volume, taker-flow, and trade-count columns

not_a_repeat_of.spot_perp_absorption: RITT-1 does not trade a fixed residual magnitude, contraction, or expansion-onset rule. The basis residual defines one half of an interaction state.
not_a_repeat_of.inventory_conservation_residual: RITT-1 does not map positive inventory residual plus carry sign directly to a static fade. Inventory ownership must interact with a basis-residual transition.
not_a_repeat_of.AOSP_1: RITT-1 uses four residual/ownership quantities, no HGB learner, no spot-participation matrix, and no fit-prediction score quantile.
not_a_repeat_of.Rank7: RITT-1 is a separate fixed-hold transition table with no Rank7 barriers, source gates, or weak-feature bundle.

source_and_feature_contract.spot_completeness: spot_rows and premium_rows must both equal 5 at the decision bar
source_and_feature_contract.funding_join: backward as-of using only published funding rows
source_and_feature_contract.missing_source_policy: fail closed at inference; no forward fill of spot or OI
source_and_feature_contract.rolling_fit_policy: every rolling mean, scale, covariance, and regression coefficient uses observations ending at t-1

features.inventory_residual: delayed OI 24h log change sequentially residualized with prior-only rolling regressions against absolute 24h return, signed 24h return, completed premium, and known funding, then prior-only z-scored
features.inventory_owner: sign of carry pressure when inventory residual is excessive; negative carry labels a short crowd and positive carry labels a long crowd; carry pressure is equal-weight prior-only z-scores of completed premium and known funding

fit_fold_thresholds.inventory_normal: not excess inventory or zero carry

state_encoding.current_state: basis state {-1,0,+1} x inventory-owner state {-1,0,+1}, yielding exactly 9 states
state_encoding.transition: state at the completed bar 144 bars earlier -> current state, yielding at most 81 transition groups
state_encoding.threshold_scope: all q20/q80 thresholds are estimated only from purged fit decisions for that annual fold

model_contract.learner: one empirical-Bayes transition utility table for each annual fold
model_contract.target: next-open fixed-hold net return after two 6bp/notional side costs minus 0.5 times side-specific leveraged intratrade MAE
model_contract.target_clip: purged fit-fold 0.5% and 99.5% winsorization independently by side
model_contract.posterior_prior: each transition-side mean shrinks toward the fit-fold global side mean with fixed prior_strength 64
model_contract.posterior_variance: pooled fit-fold side variance divided by transition_count plus prior_strength
model_contract.confidence: posterior mean minus lcb_z times posterior standard error
model_contract.activation: choose the side with higher confidence only when confidence is positive, expected-utility separation is at least 0.0001, the transition has at least 50 purged fit observations, and current state differs from previous state
model_contract.purge: a fit target is allowed only when its source-owned exit is strictly before the annual fit cutoff

execution_contract.entry: next 5m open after the completed decision bar
execution_contract.exit: fixed hold at a future 5m open; no TP or SL
execution_contract.annualization: full declared calendar window including idle cash

requirements: 2023 and 2024 absolute return are both positive
2023 and 2024 each have at least 12 trades and each half-year has at least 4 trades
standalone_pre2025.rank: maximize minimum 2023/2024 ratio, then geometric mean ratio, then minimum half-year return, then combined absolute return, then shorter hold and lower lcb_z

gross9_marginal.baseline: frozen Gross9 weights are not reoptimized
requirements: candidate is added only at frozen weights 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, or 1.00 and total gross remains <= 10
train strict MDD <= 40% and 2024 strict MDD <= 20%
train and 2024 absolute returns remain positive and at least 97% of baseline
train and 2024 Gross9 CAGR-to-strict-MDD deltas are both positive
minimum train/2024 ratio delta exceeds the same-gross pro-rata Gross9 leverage control
at least one of train or 2024 strict MDD is lower than baseline
candidate entry Jaccard versus every existing sleeve is <= 0.25
candidate has positive standalone PnL during bars when Gross9 has no open position
gross9_marginal.rank: maximize minimum train/2024 ratio delta over leverage control, then geometric mean positive ratio delta, then 2024 MDD reduction, then 2024 return delta, then lower added weight

requirements: 2025 and 2026 use only their annually expanding past-data refits
frozen portfolio 2025 and 2026 returns remain positive, strict MDD <= 20%, and ratio >= 3
neither future Gross9 ratio falls by more than 0.25 and at least one improves
standalone combined 2025-2026 absolute return is positive
10bp/side stress keeps frozen portfolio future returns positive

negative_controls_after_top1_freeze: basis-residual transition table without inventory state
inventory transition table without basis state
raw OI-change plus carry in place of inventory conservation residual
raw spot participation in place of basis residual
12-hour transition lag shifted one bar into the future must be prohibited
required_diagnostics: feature and transition-state availability by year
fit-threshold, transition-table, and activation hashes by annual fold
transition support distribution and posterior side counts
exact entry and occupied-bar overlap versus every Gross9 sleeve
zero-filled daily MTM Pearson and Spearman correlation
standalone PnL while Gross9 is flat
research_caveat: 2025/2026 have been inspected elsewhere, so future stages are veto-only and cannot restore pristine OOS status. A survivor is forward-shadow evidence, not automatic live promotion.
